/**
 * @cc-ignore missing-rule
 * Targets no inherited contract.
 */
export function orphan(): void {}

/**
 * @cc [owner:spolu,label:product] own-rule
 * Defines a contract on the ignoring declaration itself.
 */
/**
 * @cc-ignore own-rule
 * Cannot target a contract on its own declaration.
 */
export function ignoresItself(): void {}

/**
 * @cc-ignore [from:other/CONTRACTS] ignore-directory-rule
 * Names a CONTRACTS file that does not define the contract.
 */
export function wrongSource(): void {}

/**
 * @cc-ignore ignore-directory-rule
 * Ignores a directory contract once.
 */
/**
 * @cc-ignore ignore-directory-rule
 * Ignores the same directory contract again.
 */
export function ignoresTwice(): void {}
